task.title: To‘garakka yozilish formasi
task.html: Dasturlash to‘garagiga yozilish
task.description: #signup-form formasini jQuery yordamida jonlantiring. O‘quv «serveri» sendApplication(data, onSuccess) allaqachon bor: u ma’lumotlarni qabul qiladi va bir soniyadan keyin onSuccess ni chaqiradi. 1) showError($field, text) ni yozing: matn maydonning xato elementiga (uning id si maydonning aria-describedby atributida) va maydonga aria-invalid="true"; clearError($field): bo‘sh matn va aria-invalid siz. 2) validateForm() ni yozing: u barcha maydonlarni birdaniga tekshiradi va true yoki false qaytaradi. trim() dan keyin ism bo‘sh emas ("Ismingizni kiriting") va 2 ta belgidan qisqa emas ("Ism - kamida 2 ta belgi"); email @ ni o‘z ichiga oladi ("@ belgisi bor email kiriting"); yosh - 14 dan 60 gacha (shu sonlar ham kiradi) son ("Yosh - 14 dan 60 gacha son"); #direction da yo‘nalish tanlangan ("Yo‘nalishni tanlang"); #agree katakchasi belgilangan ("Qoidalarga roziligingizni tasdiqlang"). To‘g‘ri maydonlarning xatosi tozalanadi. 3) $form.on("submit", ...) ishlovchisi: brauzer yuborishini bekor qiladi, #form-message ni tozalaydi va formani tekshiradi. 4) Xatolar bo‘lmasa: #submit-btn ni bloklaydi va unga "Yuborilmoqda..." deb yozadi, sendApplication($form.serializeArray(), funksiya) ni chaqiradi. Funksiyada: #form-message ga "Rahmat, Anna! Siz yozildingiz: Veb-dasturlash." matni (trim dan keyingi ism va tanlangan yo‘nalish matni), formani tozalash, tugma yana "Yozilish" matni bilan faol. document.querySelector, innerHTML, .html() va .submit(fn) dan foydalanmang.

tests.name: Bo‘sh forma: har bir maydonning o‘z xatosi
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("", "", "", "", false); $("#signup-form").trigger("submit"); return err("name") === "Ismingizni kiriting" && err("email") === "@ belgisi bor email kiriting" && err("age") === "Yosh - 14 dan 60 gacha son" && err("direction") === "Yo‘nalishni tanlang" && err("agree") === "Qoidalarga roziligingizni tasdiqlang"; })()
tests.fail: Barcha maydonlarni ketma-ket, birinchi xatodan keyin chiqib ketmasdan tekshiring: natijani let isValid = true da to‘plang.

tests.name: Bo‘sh forma: barcha maydonlarda aria-invalid="true", ariza yuborilmagan
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("", "", "", "", false); $("#signup-form").trigger("submit"); return ["name", "email", "age", "direction", "agree"].every((id) => inv(id) === "true") && sentData.length === 0 && document.querySelector("#submit-btn").disabled === false; })()
tests.fail: showError maydonga .attr("aria-invalid", "true") qo‘yadi; xatolar bo‘lsa sendApplication chaqirilmaydi.

tests.name: Yuborish .trigger("submit") orqali sahifani qayta yuklamaydi
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("Anna", "anna@mail.uz", "20", "web", true); $("#signup-form").trigger("submit"); return __error === null && sentData.length === 1; })()
tests.fail: submit ishlovchisining boshida event.preventDefault() ni chaqiring.

tests.name: dispatchEvent orqali yuborish bekor qilingan: defaultPrevented
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("", "", "", "", false); const ev = new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); document.querySelector("#signup-form").dispatchEvent(ev); return ev.defaultPrevented === true; })()
tests.fail: event.preventDefault() formada xatolar bo‘lganda ham kerak - uni birinchi qatorda chaqiring.

tests.name: Bo‘shliqlardan va bitta harfdan iborat ism - xato
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("   ", "anna@mail.uz", "20", "web", true); $("#signup-form").trigger("submit"); const a = err("name") === "Ismingizni kiriting"; $("#name").val(" A "); $("#signup-form").trigger("submit"); return a && err("name") === "Ism - kamida 2 ta belgi" && inv("name") === "true" && err("email") === "" && inv("email") === null && sentData.length === 0; })()
tests.fail: Avval const name = $name.val().trim(); keyin name === "" va name.length < 2 tekshiruvlari.

tests.name: @ siz email - xato, qolgan maydonlar xatosiz
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("Anna", "anna.mail.uz", "20", "web", true); $("#signup-form").trigger("submit"); return err("email") === "@ belgisi bor email kiriting" && inv("email") === "true" && err("name") === "" && err("age") === "" && sentData.length === 0; })()

tests.name: Yosh: 13, 61 va bo‘sh maydon - xato; 14 va 60 - xato emas
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); const res = []; for (const a of ["13", "61", "", "14", "60"]) { fill("Anna", "anna@mail.uz", a, "web", false); $("#signup-form").trigger("submit"); res.push(err("age")); } const bad = "Yosh - 14 dan 60 gacha son"; return res.join("|") === [bad, bad, bad, "", ""].join("|") && inv("age") === null; })()
tests.fail: const age = Number($age.val()); maydon bo‘sh bo‘lsa, Number.isNaN(age), age < 14 yoki age > 60 bo‘lsa - xato. 14 va 60 chegaralari ruxsat etilgan.

tests.name: Yo‘nalish tanlanmagan va katakcha belgilanmagan - xatolar
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("Anna", "anna@mail.uz", "20", "", false); document.querySelector("#signup-form").requestSubmit(); return err("direction") === "Yo‘nalishni tanlang" && err("agree") === "Qoidalarga roziligingizni tasdiqlang" && inv("direction") === "true" && inv("agree") === "true" && sentData.length === 0; })()

tests.name: To‘g‘ri forma (requestSubmit): tugma bloklangan, matni "Yuborilmoqda..."
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("Anna", "anna@mail.uz", "20", "web", true); document.querySelector("#signup-form").requestSubmit(); return document.querySelector("#submit-btn").disabled === true && document.querySelector("#submit-btn").textContent === "Yuborilmoqda..." && sentData.length === 1 && ["name", "email", "age", "direction", "agree"].every((id) => err(id) === "" && inv(id) === null); })()

tests.name: sendApplication ga .serializeArray() ma’lumotlari uzatilgan
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("Anna", "anna@mail.uz", "20", "python", true); $("#signup-form").trigger("submit"); const d = sentData[0]; const v = (n) => (d.find((x) => x.name === n) || {}).value; return Array.isArray(d) && v("email") === "anna@mail.uz" && v("age") === "20" && v("direction") === "python" && v("agree") === "on"; })()

tests.name: «Server» javobidan keyin: xabar, forma tozalangan, tugma faol
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("Anna", "anna@mail.uz", "20", "web", true); document.querySelector("#signup-form").dispatchEvent(new Event("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const before = document.querySelector("#form-message").textContent; finishSending(); return before === "" && document.querySelector("#form-message").textContent === "Rahmat, Anna! Siz yozildingiz: Veb-dasturlash." && $("#name").val() === "" && $("#direction").val() === "" && $("#agree").prop("checked") === false && document.querySelector("#submit-btn").disabled === false && document.querySelector("#submit-btn").textContent === "Yozilish"; })()

tests.name: Tuzatilgan maydonlar xato va aria-invalid ni yo‘qotadi
tests.check: (() => { const fill = (n, e, a, d, c) => { $("#name").val(n); $("#email").val(e); $("#age").val(a); $("#direction").val(d); $("#agree").prop("checked", c); }; const err = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}-error`).textContent; const inv = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`).getAttribute("aria-invalid"); fill("", "", "", "", false); $("#signup-form").trigger("submit"); fill("Anna", "anna@mail.uz", "20", "web", true); $("#signup-form").trigger("submit"); return ["name", "email", "age", "direction", "agree"].every((id) => err(id) === "" && inv(id) === null) && sentData.length === 1; })()
tests.fail: clearError: xato elementida .text("") va maydonda .removeAttr("aria-invalid") - har bir to‘g‘ri maydon uchun.

tests.name: Dastur xatolarsiz bajariladi
tests.fail: Selektorlarni va sendApplication ikkinchi argument sifatida funksiya bilan chaqirilishini tekshiring.

hints: Barcha xatolarni birdaniga ko‘rsatish uchun birinchisidan keyin return qilmang: let isValid = true; ... isValid = false; ... return isValid;
Yosh: const age = Number($age.val()); $age.val() === "", Number.isNaN(age), age < 14 yoki age > 60 bo‘lsa - xato.
Katakcha: $agree.prop("checked"). Uning .val() qiymati belgilanmaganda ham doim "on".
Tanlangan yo‘nalish matni: $direction.find("option:checked").text(); jQuery’da .reset() yo‘q - $form[0].reset() ni chaqiring.
Xabar uchun ism va yo‘nalishni sendApplication chaqiruvidan OLDIN saqlab qo‘ying: reset() dan keyin maydonlar bo‘sh.

questions.question: Nega ishlovchi tugmaning click hodisasiga emas, formaning submit hodisasiga osiladi?
options: jQuery 4 da tugmaning click hodisasi ishlamaydi
submit ham tugma, ham maydondagi Enter orqali ishga tushadi
submit sahifa yuklanishidan oldin ishga tushadi
questions.explanation: Formani tugma yoki Enter tugmasi bilan yuborish mumkin - submit ikkala usulni ham ushlaydi.

questions.question: value atributisiz <input type="checkbox" id="agree"> katakchasi belgilanMAGAN bo‘lsa, $("#agree").val() nimani qaytaradi?
questions.explanation: Katakchaning .val() qiymati - bu holati emas, uning value qiymati. value atributisiz bu "on". Katakcha belgilanganmi - .prop("checked").

questions.question: Qaysi yozuvlar #agree katakchasi aynan hozir belgilanganini aniqlaydi?
questions.explanation: .prop va :checked joriy holatni o‘qiydi. attr - HTML’dagi boshlang‘ich atribut, val - value qiymati.

questions.question: Forma: name = Anna, age = 20, agree katakchasi belgilanmagan. $form.serializeArray() nimani qaytaradi?
options: [{ name: "name", value: "Anna" }, { name: "age", value: 20 }, { name: "agree", value: false }]
questions.explanation: serializeArray - { name, value } juftliklari massivi, qiymatlar - satrlar, belgilanmagan katakcha natijaga tushmaydi.

questions.question: Qaysi jQuery metodi formani name=%D0%90%D0%BD%D0%BD%D0%B0&age=20 ko‘rinishidagi satrga aylantiradi? Metod nomini nuqta va qavslarsiz kiriting.
questions.explanation: .serialize() serverga yuborish uchun satr beradi (9-dars), .serializeArray() - obyektlar massivi.

questions.question: Kod nimani chiqaradi? const age = $("#age").val(); console.log(typeof age); - foydalanuvchi type="number" maydoniga 25 kiritdi.
questions.explanation: Istalgan maydonning qiymati - satr. Solishtirish uchun uni Number() orqali aylantiring.

questions.question: Vazifa va yozuvni moslang.
questions.explanation: jQuery’da .reset() metodi yo‘q: u formaning DOM elementida chaqiriladi.

questions.question: Formadagi yaxshi xato xabarining xususiyatlari qaysilar?
options: Maydon yonida turadi va nimani tuzatish kerakligini aytadi
questions.explanation: alert xalaqit beradi va qaysi maydon noto‘g‘ri ekanini ko‘rsatmaydi. Xato - maydon yonida, u bilan bog‘langan va tuzatilgandan keyin yo‘qoladi.

questions.question: Ariza yuborilayotganda yuborish tugmasini nima uchun bloklash kerak?
options: Foydalanuvchi arizani ikki marta yubormasligi va yuborish ketayotganini ko‘rishi uchun
questions.explanation: Sabrsiz foydalanuvchi tugmani qayta bosadi - bloklashsiz ikkita ariza ketadi.

questions.question: Kod: if (name === "") { ... return false; } if (!email.includes("@")) { ... }. Foydalanuvchi ismni ham, emailni ham bo‘sh qoldirdi. U nechta xatoni ko‘radi?
questions.explanation: return birinchi xatodan keyin funksiyadan chiqadi. Barcha xatolarni ko‘rsatish uchun natijani let isValid = true da to‘plang.

questions.question: Xatolarni sizning kodingiz ko‘rsatishi uchun formaning qaysi atributi brauzerning o‘rnatilgan ko‘rsatmalarini o‘chiradi? Atribut nomini kiriting.
questions.explanation: <form novalidate> - tekshiruv va xato matnlarini sizning skriptingiz bajaradi, barcha brauzerlarda bir xil.

questions.question: Maydonni va foydalanuvchi nimani tanlaganini qanday bilishni moslang.
questions.explanation: Ro‘yxatda .val() bandning value qiymatini beradi, ko‘rinadigan yozuvni esa - tanlangan option ning .text() metodi.
